measured_from: sim/cache (Elexon FUELHH + demand + AGWS, NESO Carbon Intensity, NESO Historic Demand Data embedded wind+solar)
basis: gCO2/kWh, national, half-hourly, NESO/National Grid Carbon Intensity API (api.carbonintensity.org.uk, key-free, openly licensed). TWO BASES: up to 2020-04-27 period 33 the actual carries a loss uplift (about 1.14x NESO's Historic GB Generation Mix); from period 34 it is generation basis (about 1.02x), whatever the methodology text says. INCLUDES interconnector imports at NESO's fixed import factors, INCLUDES coal. Both forecast and actual are published; 'actual' is outturn.
split: fit on ODD days of the month, scored on EVEN days; whole days either side

rungs.ceiling_2d: best function of (u,v) -- the model's existing inputs
rungs.ceiling_3d: best function of (u,v,w), w = embedded generation / demand
rungs.placebo_shuffled: w dealt to other half hours -- prices the CELLS
rungs.placebo_day_mean: w replaced by its day mean -- prices the WITHIN-DAY axis
rungs.oracle_probe: w = the TARGET's within-day deviation -- INSTRUMENT CHECK, NOT PUBLISHABLE

verdict_rests_on: embedded_gain_within_day = ceiling_3d - placebo_day_mean, read against oracle_headroom_within_day
